draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.81, the 1st-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 1st of 20 at S. He went 14th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Kam Chancellor. Testing standouts: broad jump (88th percentile). Testing concerns: 40-yard dash (13th percentile), 10-yard split (14th percentile). College production: 34 tackles in 2021, 19th of 19 Ss in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 5 pro, currently with the Baltimore Ravens. 64 career games and 52 starts over 4 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Producing near his peak: 10 AV in 2025 against a career-best 13 in 2023. Strengths in 2025: approximate value 10 (96th percentile), combined tackles 105 (89th percentile), passes defended 9 (89th percentile). Weak spots: interceptions 0 (22nd percentile). Versus the typical Year-4 safety who played: 88.4% season snap share against a median of 72.3%, above the norm.
